en.topic_title: Chinese guitar capital’s stairway to export heaven
en.topic_summary:
It doesn’t take long to guess the main industry of the Chinese town of Zheng’an. A giant guitar sculpture dominates the central square, guitar murals adorn walls and pavements and even the rubbish bins are shaped like guitars.



This photo taken on July 27, 2026 shows a worker making a guitar at a guitar workshop in Zheng’an, in southwestern China’s Guizhou Province. Photo: Jade Gao/AFP.
